g.text: Meet User A, User B and User C
One borrowing need. Two private offers. One accepted agreement.
A approves both recipients. B and C each set an APR; neither sees the other’s quote.
Both transfers settle together on Canton.
Illustrative test assets • 7% simple ACT/360 • 30 days • amounts rounded
Collateral risk and deadlines remain. The review shows exact terms before acceptance.
